ablation.context_ablation: remove adaptation context -> meta MUST drop to floor; evaluated AT RUNG1 (discriminative, meta above floor); also reported at rung3 (non-discriminative when rung3 meta at floor); failure -> INVALID(discriminativeness_or_ablation), NOT H0
ablation.shuffle_structure: reuse 001A non-compositional world; meta headroom MUST collapse (<=DELTA); failure -> INVALID(discriminativeness_or_ablation), NOT H0

authorization_gate: DESIGN-ONLY until ALL of: (1) independent card audit passes TLGP-001B-R2-R1 [DONE: accept_for_prereg_freeze_only]; (2) explicit operator 'implement TLGP-001B-R2' referencing THIS frozen prereg sha256; (3) this frozen prereg exists & verifies. Prereg-freeze authorized NOW; implementation NOT authorized.
auto_remote_anchor_policy: LOCAL-ONLY default; harness performs NO git op; remote BLOCKED until scripts/push.* hardcoded-PAT rotated/removed; any remote anchor operator-initiated only, scoped explicit `git add`, NEVER `git add -A`, NEVER push.py

capacity_grid.note: IDENTICAL to R1; MUST NOT be enlarged to chase H1 or shrunk to force H0/H1

claim_ceiling: Bounded offline evidence on whether ONE world's within-episode inference headroom survives a CAPABILITY-ESTABLISHED cross-episode PRIMARY meta. Candidate-free; tests NO mechanism. NOT learning-as-mechanism, agency, self, feeling, subjectivity, intelligence, autonomy, AGI, companion-readiness, or EGO-readiness. Seen-rule rungs (0,1,2) prove ONLY optimization/representation/amortization capability and are NEVER mechanism evidence or H1. invalid_no_capability_witness means THIS family at THIS frozen budget/grid failed to provide a capability witness -- it does NOT prove the family cannot learn with more data/training/diversity. invalid_inconclusive_underpowered means the rung3 statistic could not robustly distinguish survive vs amortize at N_SEEDS=10; it is NOT a downgrade of 001A. Any negative bounded to THIS world + THIS meta family + this frozen capacity grid.

decision_statistic.H0_requires: ANY eligible primary family closes rung3: headroom_vs_meta <= DELTA on >= 9/10 seeds
decision_statistic.H1_requires: BOTH primary families eligible AND each robustly fails to close rung3: LCB(headroom) > DELTA
decision_statistic.inconclusive: neither robust-survive nor robust-close (CI straddles DELTA, or only one primary eligible & not closing) -> INVALID(inconclusive), NEVER auto-H0
decision_statistic.rung_pass_close: headroom <= DELTA on >= 9/10 seeds (same close rule for rung0/rung1/H0)

family_roles.rule: diagnostic family is recorded but NEVER gates the global verdict; eligibility E = set of PRIMARY families passing rung0 AND rung1

question: Does TLGP-001A's within-episode headroom survive a CAPABILITY-ESTABLISHED cross-episode meta-learner, where capability is witnessed by a graded ladder that holds rule-novelty OUT before the unseen-rule test?

replay_requirements.exactness: ideal exact; baseline/meta from recorded preds exact (<=1e-12); retraining reproducibility checked separately via frozen seeds
replay_requirements.from_trace_no_retrain: recompute rung0/rung1 pass booleans, E, scanner outputs, ideal + baselines + meta balanced accuracy, AND the full verdict from recorded predictions vs ground truth WITHOUT retraining

replay_requirements.record_every_rung: EVERY rung's per-seed per-episode predictions for PRIMARY and DIAGNOSTIC families, INCLUDING rung0 (0a fit + 0b heldout) and rung1 capability witness (fixes R1 gap: R1 recorded only REAL preds)

rung1_scanner.interpretation_rule: rung1 is a capability witness, NOT required to fully beat baselines; BUT if cheap_baseline_saturation is set, rung1 proves ONLY 'training path runs' and does NOT establish 'meta uses context'; in that case context-ablation collapse at rung1 is the load-bearing check

rung0_learnability_floor.pass_rule: both 0a AND 0b >= (ideal_R0 - DELTA) on >= 9/10 seeds, per primary family
rung0_learnability_floor.purpose: optimization/representation capacity floor (Zhang-style); rule out implementation/budget bug (bucket A)

rung1_seen_rule_capability.claim_ceiling: proves ONLY in-distribution amortization/retrieval of SEEN rules at THIS frozen budget/grid; NOT mechanism/generalization/H1; NEVER mechanism evidence
rung1_seen_rule_capability.pass_rule: meta_balacc >= (ideal_seen1 - DELTA) on >= 9/10 seeds, per primary family -> ELIGIBILITY
rung1_seen_rule_capability.purpose: PRIMARY capability witness; isolate seen-rule amortization from unseen-rule extrapolation

rung3_real_unseen_rule_unseen_value.purpose: the experiment (= R1 REAL): unseen-rule + unseen-value

set rung3 CI straddling DELTA -> INVALID(inconclusive)
close rung3 for one eligible primary -> H0
tamper_requirements.requirement: each of the 7 terminal branches MUST be uniquely fire-able by >=1 frozen synthetic tamper axis; report booleans + neutral classes only (never the enum string)

training_budget.only_permitted_cross_rung_difference: DATA (which rules / which values / seen vs unseen) -- never compute/architecture/budget

verdict_enum.note: H0 and H1 are AFFIRMATIVE; there is NO else->H0. 7 mutually-exclusive terminals; each must be uniquely fire-able by a tamper axis.
precedence_computed: 1. INVALID(leakage_or_replay) iff any planted leak uncaught OR any clean channel falsely flagged OR replay not exact for ANY rung
2. else INVALID(learnability_floor_failed) iff NO primary family passes rung0 (>=9/10)
3. else INVALID(no_capability_witness) iff >=1 primary passes rung0 but E=empty (no primary passes rung1)

4. else INVALID(discriminativeness_or_ablation) iff for any eligible primary family context-ablation does NOT collapse (rung1 meta not <= FLOOR+DELTA w/o context) OR shuffle does NOT collapse (headroom > DELTA on non-compositional world)
5. else H0 iff EXISTS family in E that closes rung3 (headroom <= DELTA on >=9/10)
6. else H1 iff E superset-of {in_context_gru,in_context_transformer} AND both robustly fail to close rung3 (LCB(headroom) > DELTA each) AND step4 passed
